title: Annotate Anvio Gene Calls for Function and Taxonomy
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gczbsx6

steps.title: Initialize HPC Environment
steps.instruction: Log in to the HPC and navigate to the user directory.

substeps.instruction: Run: ssh hpcice ssh hpc ice
Run: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/user_id

steps.title: Create Analysis Directories
steps.instruction: Create the necessary directory structure to store taxonomy and function analysis results.

substeps.instruction: mkdir taxonomy-genes
mkdir taxonomy-genes/std-err
mkdir taxonomy-genes/std-out
mkdir anvio-genes
mkdir function-genes
mkdir function-genes/std-err
mkdir function-genes/std-out

steps.title: Extract and Transfer Gene Calls
steps.instruction: Extract DNA sequences for gene calls using Anvi'o and transfer the resulting file to the HPC.

substeps.instruction: In the Anvi'o terminal, run: anvi-get-dna-sequences-for-gene-calls -c contigs.db -o nucleotides.faa
Transfer the file to the HPC: scp nucleotides.faa sftp.hpc.arizona.edu:/rsgrps/bh_class/username/anvio-genes
Verify the file exists on the HPC: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username/anvio-genes && ls -l nucleotides.faa

steps.title: Perform Taxonomic Analysis
steps.instruction: Run taxonomic analysis on gene calls using Centrifuge via a PBS script.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the directory: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/bhurwitz/taxonomy-genes

Create a script named 'centrifuge_tax.sh' with the following parameters: FASTA="/rsgrps/bh_class/username/anvio-genes/nucleotides.faa", OUT_DIR="/rsgrps/bh_class/username/taxonomy-genes", and CENT_DB="/rsgrps/bh_class/b_compressed+h+v/b_compressed+h+v". The script should execute: centrifuge -x $CENT_DB -U $FASTA -S $OUT_DIR/centrifuge_hits.tsv --report-file $OUT_DIR/centrifuge_report.tsv -f
Make the script executable: chmod 755 centrifuge_tax.sh
Submit the job: qsub -o std-out/ -e std-err/ centrifuge_tax.sh

steps.title: Perform Functional Analysis
steps.instruction: Run functional analysis to identify top PFAM and KEGG IDs using UPROC.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the directory: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username/function-genes

Create a script named 'uproc_function.sh' with the following parameters: FASTA="/rsgrps/bh_class/username/anvio-genes/nucleotides.faa", OUT_DIR="/rsgrps/bh_class/username/function-genes", and OUTPUT="$OUT_DIR/uproc-out".

The script should export UPROC="/rsgrps/bh_class/bin/uproc-dna", DATA="/rsgrps/bh_class/data/uproc", UPROC_MODEL="$DATA/model", UPROC_OUT_DIR="$OUT_DIR/uproc-out", PFAM="$DATA/pfam27ready", and KEGG="$DATA/keggready".
The script should execute UPROC for PFAM: $UPROC --preds --short --threads 12 --output $OUTPUT.pfam $PFAM $UPROC_MODEL $FASTA
The script should execute UPROC for KEGG: $UPROC --preds --short --threads 12 --output $OUTPUT.kegg $KEGG $UPROC_MODEL $FASTA
Make the script executable: chmod 755 uproc_function.sh
Submit the job: qsub -o std-out/ -e std-err/ uproc_function.sh

steps.title: Format Functional Data for Anvi'o
steps.instruction: Convert UPROC functional data into Anvi'o compatible format using a Perl script.

substeps.instruction: Create a Perl script 'format-anvio.pl' (using /uaopt/perl/5.14.2/bin/perl) to map UPROC IDs to descriptions and output a tab-delimited file with columns: gene_callers_id, source, accession, function, e_value.
Make the script executable: chmod 755 format-anvio.pl
Process KEGG data: ./format-anvio.pl uproc-out.kegg /rsgrps/bh_class/kegg_to_desc uproc-kegg-anvio kegg
Process PFAM data: ./format-anvio.pl uproc-out.pfam /rsgrps/bh_class/pfam_to_domain uproc-pfam-anvio pfam
Combine results into a matrix: cat uproc-kegg-anvio > input_matrix.txt
Append PFAM results (excluding header): egrep -v "gene_callers_id" uproc-pfam-anvio >> input_matrix.txt

steps.title: Download Results to Local Machine
steps.instruction: Transfer the processed functional and taxonomic files from the HPC to the local Anvi'o working directory.

substeps.instruction: Download functional matrix: scp netid@sftp.hpc.arizona.edu:/rsgrps/bh_class/username/function-genes/input_matrix.txt .
Download taxonomic report: scp netid@sftp.hpc.arizona.edu:/rsgrps/bh_class/username/taxonomy-genes/centrifuge_report.tsv .
Download taxonomic hits: scp netid@sftp.hpc.arizona.edu:/rsgrps/bh_class/username/taxonomy-genes/centrifuge_hits.tsv .

steps.title: Import Data into Anvi'o
steps.instruction: Upload the taxonomic and functional data into the Anvi'o database.

substeps.instruction: Import taxonomy: anvi-import-taxonomy -c contigs.db -i centrifuge_report.tsv centrifuge_hits.tsv -p centrifuge
Import functions: anvi-import-functions -c contigs.db -i input_matrix.txt
